name: Maya R.
text: We brought our daughter home from the hospital yesterday. Running on two hours of sleep and pure joy. Any tips for surviving the first month? #newbaby #newparents

name: Dan K.
text: Baby number two arrives in March! Starting to think about all the grown-up stuff: bigger car, wills, savings. Where do people even start? #pregnancy #dadtobe

name: Priya S.
text: First week back at work after maternity leave. Leaving my son at daycare was harder than I expected. #workingmom #newbaby

text: Our new baby is finally here! A 2025 hatchback in electric blue. Best purchase this year. #newcar

text: Twins due in six weeks and I keep making spreadsheets of everything we need. Is it normal to panic about money this much? #twins #pregnancy

name: Ahmed B.
text: Just welcomed our first baby, Yusuf. Grateful beyond words to the midwives who stayed with us all night. #newbaby

name: Chloe T.
text: WE GOT THE KEYS! After two years of saving and four rejected offers, we finally own our first home. #firsthome #homeowner

text: Closing on our first house next Friday. The lender keeps sending documents I do not understand. What should first-time buyers double check? #firsttimehomebuyer

text: Mortgage approved! Now the scary part: realising we are responsible for this for the next 25 years. #mortgage #firsthome

text: NEW LISTING! 3 bed, 2 bath, move-in ready. DM us today for a viewing. Limited time offer! #realestate #firsthome #househunting

text: Moved into our new place with a toddler and a dog. Boxes everywhere, but it finally feels like ours. #newhome

name: Nina F.
text: House hunting update: lost another bidding war. Starting to wonder if we will ever own a home in this city. #househunting

name: Grace L.
text: My dad passed away on Sunday. I keep picking up the phone to call him. I do not know how to do any of this. #grief

text: One year since we lost Mum. Sorting through her paperwork made me realise how little we had planned as a family. Talk to your parents, people. #grief #loss

text: The funeral was beautiful. Thank you to everyone who sent flowers and messages for my mother. #lossofaparent
